verdict.rationale: Data residency or region selection is a fair question for a cloud accounting SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions where data is stored, hosting regions, or any user choice of residency. The items cover invoicing, bookkeeping, the API, versioning and the changelog, none of which bear on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
